setup: Scenario A: repo has .cor/config.md with no '## Delegation' section, and the agent exposes a subagent tool.
Scenario B: repo has .cor/config.md with '## Delegation' set to 'enabled' and 'Worker model: sonnet', but the agent exposes no subagent tool.
Scenario C: same config as B, the agent exposes a subagent tool, but it rejects the model name 'sonnet'.
In every scenario .cor/plan.md has T01 unchecked.
expected_behavior: Scenario A: implements T01 in the main session, starts no subagent, and does not mention delegation
Scenario B: implements T01 in the main session without failing or asking the user about delegation
Scenario C: runs the subagent without a model parameter and tells the user once that the worker used the session model and why
Scenario C: does not substitute another model name of its own choosing
In every scenario: checkpoint, checks, plan checkbox, notes, and commit behave exactly as without delegation
